localChanges: A city with City Walls now shows them on the map, as Civilization draws them, on your rivals' cities as well as your own (closes #688).
In Civilization II games, a city also shows walls while its owner's Great Wall stands, as the Wonder is City Walls in every one of their cities (#1069).

log: The descriptors' new `cities.walls` names `map/fortify` for a walled city, as Civ1 draws its fortified unit's frame over a city with City Walls (civ-clone/web-renderer#688). The square pack draws it a pixel in, as Civ1 does, so a garrisoned city's occupied box still shows on its top and left; the renderer cuts off what reaches past the tile. No sprite changes. 0.2.2.
